name: not-a-typo
why: Opens on "The bonds return two hundred and seventy-two percent annually. This looks like a typo.", builds the division out of money, and lands on the fat cat who only reads his MORAL FRAMEWORK once he's been paid.

name: subscription-to-suffering
why: "Why one billion dollars?": the opposition's subscription to SUFFERING against one billion paid ONCE, fired from a cannon at the treaty, ending on the weeping general's medal and "the only kind of strategy your species respects."

name: the-whole-thing-on-one-line
why: "The Whole Thing on One Line. Invest one billion dollars. Get two point seven two billion dollars a year. Forever.", then the reflex, the four questions and the sleeping fat cat corking the bottle, ending on "Attention." (trim the hold after it).
